newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 11 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 11 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Thursday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.81 percent and 17.77 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 11.199 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 10.999 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction dates and maturity dates for both issues overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 6,607 million levs 4,592.1 million levs
Bids approved 6,407 million levs 4,592.1 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.81 pct 17.77 pct
